series: Chanakya Ki Chaturbhuj: The Distant Warmth
title: Chanakya Ki Chaturbhuj: The Distant Warmth
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: A kind, warm male voice, like a storyteller.

Raja Vikram.look: A regal Indian king, mid-40s, fair skin, with a sharp, intelligent face that can show humor or sternness. Dressed in a rich golden-embroidered red sherwani and a matching turban.

Gopal.look: A lean, hopeful Indian man, 30s, fair skin, with a kind but worried expression. Dressed in worn, simple cotton kurta and dhoti.

Chanakya.look: A wise and calm Indian advisor, 50s, fair skin, with a thoughtful smile and intelligent eyes. Dressed in a simple white dhoti and kurta.

scenes.image: Raja Vikram, in regal attire, looks sternly at Gopal, who stands shivering but determined in worn clothes. Close-up on their faces, showing the contrast in power and resolve.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Raja ne di ek mushkil chunauti!
scenes.say: राजा ने दी एक मुश्किल चुनौती!

scenes.image: Gopal, looking thin and a bit downtrodden but with kind eyes, stands in a simple village setting, his worn clothes highlighting his poverty. He looks hopeful.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ek gareeb aadmi tha, Gopal naam.
scenes.say: एक गरीब आदमी था, गोपाल नाम।

scenes.image: Raja Vikram sits regally on his golden throne, stroking his chin thoughtfully, a serious expression on his face as he ponders a decision.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Raja Vikram ne ek shart rakhi.
scenes.say: राजा विक्रम ने एक शर्त रखी।

scenes.image: Gopal, bundled in his thin clothes, stands alone in a vast, dark desert under a starry sky. His breath forms mist, indicating extreme cold. A tiny, glowing lamp is visible far, far in the distance.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Jo raat bhar thande registaan mein khada rahega...
scenes.say: जो रात भर ठंडे रेगिस्तान में खड़ा रहेगा...

scenes.image: Raja Vikram holds up a large, overflowing bag of gold coins with a triumphant smile, showcasing the lavish reward. Bright light glints off the coins.
scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.image: Gopal, despite shivering, looks determined. He nods his head firmly, eyes showing a blend of fear and resolve. Close-up on his face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Gopal ne himmat se haami bhari.
scenes.say: गोपाल ने हिम्मत से हामी भरी।

scenes.image: Gopal, seen from behind, is still in the freezing desert, but his gaze is fixed on the distant, tiny lamp. A faint, tired smile of endurance plays on his lips.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Poori raat woh ek deepak dekh kar bacha.
scenes.say: पूरी रात वो एक दीपक देख कर बचा।

scenes.image: Raja Vikram points an accusing finger at Gopal, his face stern and unyielding. Gopal looks shocked, his hope turning to dismay.
scenes.speaker: Raja Vikram

scenes.image: Gopal pleads with Raja Vikram, his hands joined in namaste, a look of desperation and confusion on his face. He gestures vaguely towards the distant lamp.
scenes.speaker: Gopal
scenes.line: Maharaj, woh toh bahut door tha!
scenes.say: महाराज, वो तो बहुत दूर था!

scenes.image: Raja Vikram turns his back to Gopal, his posture stiff and stubborn, signifying his refusal. Gopal stands defeated, shoulders slumped.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Raja ne inaam dene se mana kiya.
scenes.say: राजा ने इनाम देने से मना किया।

scenes.image: Chanakya, with a knowing and mischievous twinkle in his eye, stands looking thoughtful, a slight smile forming on his lips as an idea sparks.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Tab Chanakya ne ek yojana banayi.
scenes.say: तब चाणक्य ने एक योजना बनाई।

scenes.image: Chanakya stands holding a ridiculously long stick, from which a pot of rice hangs precariously high above the ground. Below it, a tiny, almost invisible flame flickers.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne chawal ka bartan duur latkaya.
scenes.say: उसने चावल का बर्तन दूर लटकाया।

scenes.image: Raja Vikram looks utterly bewildered at Chanakya's cooking setup, pointing at the distant pot with a confused and incredulous expression.
scenes.speaker: Raja Vikram

scenes.image: Chanakya smiles knowingly, his gaze firm as he gestures from the tiny flame towards the high-hanging pot. Raja Vikram's eyes widen in sudden realization, a moment of 'aha!'
scenes.speaker: Chanakya
scenes.line: Usi garmi se, jo deepak ne di!
scenes.say: उसी गर्मी से, जो दीपक ने दी!

scenes.image: Raja Vikram throws his head back, laughing heartily, slapping his knee in amusement as he fully grasps the irony. Gopal beams with a relieved smile in the background.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Raja apni galti par bahut hase.
scenes.say: राजा अपनी गलती पर बहुत हँसे।

scenes.image: Raja Vikram, still smiling, hands the heavy bag of gold coins to Gopal, whose face is filled with joy and gratitude. Both look happy.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ant mein Gopal ko inaam mila. Kya raja sahi tha?
scenes.say: अंत में गोपाल को इनाम मिला। क्या राजा सही था?

caption: King Denied Reward, Then Advisor's 'Cooking' Twist! 🤔
yt_title: King Denied Reward, Then Advisor's 'Cooking' Twist! 🤔
description:
A poor man endures a freezing night for a king's challenge. But the king's logic for denying him the reward is baffling. Watch how the wise advisor solves this hilariously!
Who do you think was right in the end?
comment_question: Kya Raja Vikram sahi the? Haan ya Na?
